default_target.description: The default built-in script to run if no command line argument is specified. Valid values include: emmc, emmc_all, fat_write, nand, nvme_all, qspi, sd, sd_all, spi_nand, spl.

usb_polling_period_ms.description: USB polling period in milliseconds. Corresponds to the -pp flag.

timeout_known_usb_seconds.description: Timeout in seconds for waiting for a known USB device to appear. Corresponds to the -t flag.

timeout_stage_switch_seconds.description: Timeout in seconds for waiting for the next USB device at stage switch. Corresponds to the -T flag.

disable_small_memory.description: If true, disables small memory optimization. Corresponds to the -dm flag.

verbose_mode.description: If true, enables standard verbose mode. Corresponds to the -v flag.

verbose_error_mode.description: If true, enables verbose mode with libusb error/warning info. Corresponds to the -V flag.

use_bmap_files.description: If true, tries to use .bmap files even if flash commands do not specify them. Corresponds to the -bmap flag.

ignore_bmap_files.description: If true, ignores .bmap files even if flash commands specify them. Corresponds to the -no-bmap flag.

daemon_mode.description: If true, runs in daemon mode, waiting forever for devices. Corresponds to the -d flag.

dry_run_mode.description: If true, performs a dry run to check correctness without executing. Corresponds to the -dry flag.

usb_path_filter.description: List of USB path filters to restrict monitoring to specific devices (e.g., bus:port). Corresponds to the -m flag. Items are strings in format 'bus:port'.

serial_prefix_filter.description: List of serial number prefixes to monitor. Corresponds to the -ms flag. Items are strings.

environment_variables.description: List of environment variable key=value pairs to pass to the uuu execution context. Corresponds to the -e flag. Items are strings like 'UBOOT_ENV=1'.
